import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { orders } from "./orders";
import { customerDemographics } from "./customer_demographics";

export const customers = defineTable("customers", {
    columns: {
        customerId: col.varchar({ length: 5 }).primaryKey(),
        companyName: col.varchar({ length: 40 }).notNull(),
        contactName: col.varchar({ length: 30 }),
        contactTitle: col.varchar({ length: 30 }),
        address: col.varchar({ length: 60 }),
        city: col.varchar({ length: 15 }),
        region: col.varchar({ length: 15 }),
        postalCode: col.varchar({ length: 10 }),
        country: col.varchar({ length: 15 }),
        phone: col.varchar({ length: 24 }),
        fax: col.varchar({ length: 24 })
    },
    relations: {
        orders: rel.hasMany(() => orders),
        customer_demographics: rel.manyToMany(() => customerDemographics, {
            through: "customer_customer_demo",
            targetKey: "customer_type_id"
        })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
